'''Shark Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] unit made up of [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] subfighters. Loyal to [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], they participated in the [[Genocide on Dac]].

==History==
Following [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s decree that the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were to be exterminated, the [[Acklay-class mobile fortress|Acklay Battle Fortress]], ''[[Sea Lion]]'', which contained Shark Squadron, pursued Mon Calamari refugees on the ocean floor of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. After discovering a refugee camp, Shark Squadron was deployed to wipe out the settlement. However, just as the [[Skirmish on Dac|attack had begun]], Shark Squadron was attacked by the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] in their [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana]] subfighters. The unit began to take casualties, and despite efforts by the commander of the ''Sea Lion'', [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Sturves]], to aid the Sharks, the squadron was slowly pushed away from the Mon Calamari civilians.

[[File:SharkSquadron.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Shark Squadron in battle with the Mon Calamari Rangers.]]

Eventually, the Rangers' ally, [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]], damaged the ''Sea Lion'', causing Commander Sturves to abandon the attack. Shark Squadron was recalled to cover the retreat, and the Imperials left the battleground.
